title: Training history
description: SEAM 3. results/metrics/<run_id>/history.json - the per-epoch training record. Produced by Member 3 (trainer); consumed by Member 3 for the Section 4 loss curves, by Member 1 for mean_epoch_time_s in resources.json, and by Member 4 for the Section 3 optimizer comparison. Committed to git so nobody re-runs training to redraw a plot.

run_id.description: Must equal the directory name and be derived from edgecnn.contracts.paths.make_run_id.

model.description: Registry key, e.g. 'model_b'. Must match the model component of run_id.

optimizer.description: Must match the optimizer component of run_id. Section 3 requires at least sgd, sgd_momentum and one chosen optimizer.

device.description: Hardware the run executed on. Section 4 requires the evaluation hardware to be reported, and epoch times are meaningless without it.

epochs.description: One entry per completed epoch. minItems is 20 because the assignment mandates at least 20 epochs - a short debug run must not be committed as a result.

lr.description: Learning rate actually used this epoch, after any scheduler step.

epoch_time_s.description: Wall-clock seconds for the training pass plus the validation pass. Measured only by Member 3's trainer so every model is timed identically.

hyperparameters.description: Flat snapshot of what produced this run: learning rate, batch size, weight decay, momentum, scheduler, augmentation. Section 3 and 4 both require these to be stated.
